chosen_by: pre-registered rule on 75 synthetic tuning scenarios (data/processed/composer_eval/summary.json)
taste_signal: PROXY: BaselineRanker content cosine to 5 random favourites; re-run with survey ratings as the taste oracle before treating these as final
how_to_apply: backend/src/tastoria/app.py builds MealDeps(...) with the default composer.Params(); pass MealDeps(params=Params(version='tray-p1-synthetic-20261018', alpha=…, beta=…, gamma=…)) there, or change the defaults of Params in backend/src/tastoria/modules/meal/composer.py. meal_plans.params_version records the version on every plan.
